parsed.draft_response:
Hi — I’m sorry this is happening again and that it’s impacting you urgently. We can help, but I’ll need a couple of details to quickly pinpoint what’s failing.

Please reply with:
1) What exact feature/workflow is broken (what were you trying to do when it fails)?
2) Any error message shown (copy/paste) or a screenshot.
3) When it started and whether it’s constant or intermittent.
4) Your environment: tenant/org name (if applicable), and your browser/app version.
5) “The same thing as last time”: if you have the prior incident/ticket link or a brief description of the earlier problem, share that.

As soon as I have this, we’ll escalate to engineering to investigate and get it back to working. If you can, include any recent changes on your side (integrations, credentials, exports/imports, or config changes) right before it began.
promised_actions: Escalate the issue to engineering once the missing details are provided
Investigate the reported failure based on the information you share
safety_notes: Issue scope and root cause are unknown; response requests minimal necessary clarification.
No refund, fix guarantee, or SLA is promised.
